customer_name: Siam AI Corporation Co., Ltd. (Siam.AI Cloud)
business_problem: Thailand tourism information was fragmented across multiple websites, difficult to verify, often outdated, and hard for visitors to access across languages, creating poor experiences and inefficient support workflows.
solution_summary: Siam AI and Wipro built an AI tourism assistant called Sukjai on top of SiamGPT so visitors could get reliable travel information through a single multilingual interface instead of navigating disconnected websites. The implementation starts with tourism content from the Tourism Authority of Thailand and additional curated travel data, which Siam AI verifies and improves before using it to train and ground the model. NVIDIA NeMo provides the framework for building the tourism-specialized language model, NeMo Curator prepares the source corpus, and NeMo Retriever grounds responses in approved tourism knowledge. NVIDIA NIM then packages the model as reusable services that can be delivered through web apps, mobile apps, and APIs, giving Siam AI a modular stack for real-time tourist assistance.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA NeMo
solution_components.role: Provides the model-development framework used to build the tourism-focused language model on SiamGPT.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA NeMo Curator
solution_components.role: Prepares and improves the tourism data corpus before it is used for training and grounding.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA NeMo Retriever
solution_components.role: Grounds answers in verified tourism knowledge so the assistant can respond accurately to visitor questions.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA NIM
solution_components.role: Packages the assistant as reusable inference microservices that can be delivered through multiple application channels.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA AI Enterprise
solution_components.role: Provides the enterprise software foundation for deploying the tourism assistant stack in production.

data_flow: Tourism information from the Tourism Authority of Thailand and other sources is verified and curated, then prepared with NeMo Curator for model training and retrieval grounding. Visitor questions are answered through NIM-hosted services that use NeMo-based models and NeMo Retriever to return approved travel guidance across web, mobile, and API delivery channels.
integration_points: Web applications, mobile applications, and APIs
business_outcome: Siam AI created a single assistant that can give tourists more reliable and timely information across languages while also giving Thailand tourism stakeholders a modular way to distribute verified destination knowledge through web, mobile, and API channels.
architecture_clues: Sukjai is the tourism assistant persona built on SiamGPT
The initial model specialization focused on Thai tourism
The platform is designed for web apps, mobile apps, and API integration
The data corpus is verified before being used to ground answers
evidence_quotes: Before the NVIDIA-powered solution was implemented, tourists struggled with fragmented information spread across multiple websites, concerns about information authenticity, outdated content, and language barriers.
The integration of NVIDIA's advanced technologies-particularly the NVIDIA NeMo framework and NVIDIA NIM-enabled the development of a sophisticated tourism assistant platform called Sukjai.
The training data for this model comprises tourism information provided by the Tourism Authority of Thailand.
SiamGPT features a modular design and supports multiple usage formats, including web applications, mobile applications, and API integration.
